compliance.label: Compliance
compliance.heading: Prepare the stay reporting setup
compliance.purpose: Choose who reports guest details. Requirements depend on the property's country.
compliance.title: Who reports to Italian police and ISTAT?
compliance.text: Choose whether to handle reporting manually or through your channel manager. The guided setup saves the choice along with any required credentials and delegation.
compliance.saved: Your sender choice is saved. The guided setup shows verification status and any issues: a saved choice does not guarantee active reporting.
compliance.missing: You still need to confirm how reporting is handled. The manual default is not your confirmation.
compliance.required: Configure and save the reporting sender in the Compliance step before continuing.
compliance.localText: This property outside Italy does not require an Italian CIN, Alloggiati Web or ISTAT setup. Do not enter Italian credentials here.
compliance.localPending: For a Swiss property, check guest registration, permits and tourist tax with the relevant canton and municipality. This step does not certify that local obligations have been completed.

billing.label: Invoicing
billing.heading: Who issues the stay documents?
billing.purpose: Complete the issuer's identity and tax regime. Details already saved for the organization are reused.
billing.title: Issuer identity and tax regime
billing.text: Provide the issuer's name, address, country and VAT treatment in the Invoicing setup. CasaZen reuses these details for your organization's properties.
billing.saved: The issuer's identity and tax regime are complete. Review numbering, automation and any other outstanding setup details in the guided flow.
billing.missing: Some issuer identity or tax regime details are missing. Complete them before finishing the property.
billing.required: Complete the issuer's identity and tax regime in the Invoicing step before continuing.
